Really??  We have a commit that is 30k lines of code?  And the commit has a date of "March 12, 2024" but was only uploaded to Gerrit yesterday.  That code was merged in less than 24 hours.

Please don't work on giant commits downstream and then shove them into Gerrit.  If the maintainers continue with this behavior it will need to be escalated to the TOF.
How do you even have a commit that is 30k lines of code without a single review comment?
